subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**recognised**" means acknowledged or accepted, especially as being valid or having a particular status. It fits the context because tobacco smoke has long been acknowledged or recognized as a proven carcinogen.
 
• The other options: "**misread**," "**behaved**," and "**neglected**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Tobacco smoke has been well recognised__ as a proven carcinogen and cancer cause for many years.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Misread (गलत पढ़ना)**: means to read wrongly or to misunderstand.
 
• **Behaved (व्यवहार किया)**: means to act in a particular way.
 
• **Neglected (उपेक्षित)**: means to give little attention or respect to.
